title: Create a reusable margin formula
scenario: Gorvani Sales records 40 fictitious product lines with revenue and cost in CAD. Blank cost means Missing; zero revenue means Zero revenue, unless cost is missing first. Otherwise margin is 100 × (revenue − cost) / revenue.

lesson.intro: A LAMBDA captures a rule; MAP applies that rule to corresponding values. State exception precedence before reusing a calculation across a whole column.

functions.name: LAMBDA
functions.arguments: Optional parameters name inputs (up to 253); calculation returns the result. Call an inline function with arguments or assign it a name in Name Manager.
functions.useCase: Reuse a margin or orientation-mean rule.
functions.mistake: An uncalled inline LAMBDA returns #CALC!; call argument counts must match.

functions.name: MAP
functions.arguments: array1 and optional aligned arrays supply values; the final LAMBDA has one parameter per array and returns one result per position.
functions.mistake: Each call must return one value; mismatched parameters error.

lesson.combine: Review IF, ISNUMBER and ROUND. Name revenue, cost and costKnown parameters; compute costKnown with ISNUMBER on the original source before MAP can coerce a blank. Call the function inline or define MarginPct in Name Manager. Missing cost takes precedence over zero revenue. Any valid formula is accepted; margin is a percentage number.

tasks.prompt: Call a reusable margin calculation for the second source line. Return a percentage rounded to two decimals or the stated exception label.
Return margins for the first eight source lines (8 × 1), with the stated rounding and exception precedence.
For the first eight lines, return Strong for numeric rounded margin ≥ 20, Thin below 20, or Review for either exception label.
Return total known profit across all 40 lines, including zero-revenue lines with numeric cost. Exclude unknown cost. Submit unrounded CAD.

bonus.prompt: Review COUNTIFS: count Review classifications in the first-eight task-3 results.

columns.name: Revenue_CAD
columns.description: Nonnegative revenue, CAD; zero is valid.

columns.name: Cost_CAD
columns.description: Numeric cost in CAD, or blank unknown cost.
